calendar_note: All numerical dates are editorial proposals to test causality and generational spacing. No date is LOCKED; do not infer character ages from them.

records.name: Before the First Fracture
records.summary: The Weave holds reality together before formal covenant institutions exist.
records.qualification: Only the Weave and post-Fracture origin of Oaths are locked; all social detail is withheld.

records.name: The First Fracture
records.summary: The Weave is damaged; surviving communities begin stabilizing local forces.
records.qualification: The event is locked; the editorial date and survivor response are proposed.

records.name: Local compacts
records.summary: Distinct civic practices begin coalescing into the fifteen living Oaths.
records.qualification: Overlapping founding period; no mandatory order or single founder is claimed.

records.name: Recognition of the major realms
records.summary: The fifteen institutions acquire durable territorial administrations while retaining mixed populations.
records.qualification: This is a proposed political consolidation, not the birth of the elements.

records.name: The navigators exchange
records.summary: Coastal and celestial scholars formalize parallel uses of Tidal while preserving independent covenants.
records.qualification: Explicit optional explanation of the shared word; no merged predecessor Oath.

records.name: Pass and relay charters
records.summary: Cross-realm routes gain shared maintenance duties and fallback access rules.
records.qualification: Charters explain interdependence without assuming modern neutral institutions always existed.

records.name: Expansion of civic networks
records.summary: Living roots, machine utilities, message relays and preservation services expand into ordinary households.
records.qualification: Benefits and dependency grow together; development is uneven across regions.

records.name: Mutual relief compacts
records.summary: A sequence of regional disasters leads to aid agreements that later become contested debt and authority.
records.qualification: Disasters remain unnamed pending additional approval; no invented continent-wide war is required.

records.name: Restrictive archive seals
records.summary: Dangerous Fracture material is placed under contested access controls.
records.qualification: The Archivist later investigates the seals; their age and tenure remain unspecified.

records.name: The Archivist studies the fragment
records.summary: The Archivist identifies evidence that one bearer may mediate multiple covenant claims.
records.qualification: Discovery circumstances, acquisition and exact duration remain open for approval.

records.name: Death at the plaza
records.summary: The Archivist dies on Daybreak's great-plaza steps, names the player successor and entrusts the original fragment.
records.qualification: Only the event is locked; present=0 is an editorial reference, not an approved in-world calendar.

records.name: The player's settlements
records.summary: Regional choices create the evidence and service plans needed for a final covenant decision.
records.qualification: Order and elapsed duration are player-dependent; no fixed universal completion date.

records.name: A revised order
records.summary: Restoration, Dominion or Liberation changes the player's narrative covenant settlement.
records.qualification: Working direction names; each has costs and continuation obligations.
